newsitem.title: USA: Smith Barney wins bulk of Nassau County, N.Y. BANs.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney wins bulk of Nassau County, N.Y. BANs.

text.p: Smith Barney won Tuesday $147 million of the $166 million of Nassau County, N.Y., bond anticipation notes (BANs) sold through competitive auction.
Smith Barney won the notes with a net interest cost (NIC) of 3.6104 percent and a coupon of 4.50 percent.
Prudential Securities won $10 million of the notes with a net interest cost of 3.5796 percent and a coupon of 4 percent.
AH Williams & Co won $10 million of the notes with a net interest cost of 3.571 percent and a coupon of 4 percent.
